description: A company commander must publish the next-day maintenance plan for two power generators using one maintenance team, setting the service order and exact work windows while recording the coordination needed for the required replacement part.

shared_context.S1: Generators G-12 and G-19 both require scheduled preventive maintenance tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: One maintenance team is available, with a normal work block from 0800 to 1200 and a second work block from 1300 to 1700.
shared_context.S3: Capt. Morgan issues the final maintenance priority and scheduling order.
shared_context.S4: The motor pool normally uses the morning maintenance huddle to confirm equipment status, parts availability, and the next-day work sequence before the commander publishes the plan.

PF1.text: SFC Patel's diagnostic check this morning confirmed that G-12 needs only exactly 2 hours of maintenance rather than the nominal 4-hour service block; the completed diagnostic sheet is still being filed and has not been added to the commander's planning packet.

PF2.text: G-19 cannot be serviced until its replacement controller arrives at exactly 1230 tomorrow, and the controller requires exactly 4 hours of installation and testing; Sgt. Lawson received the carrier confirmation this afternoon, but the delivery ticket is not yet posted on the motor pool status board.

acceptance_conditions: G-12 must be scheduled from 0800 to exactly 1000.
G-19 must be scheduled from exactly 1300 to 1700.
The plan must include a commitment to confirm receipt of G-19's replacement controller.
The controller delivery fact must be cited by the commander as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'controller_receipt_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'G-19' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 2-hour G-12 service changes its required completion time from the nominal 1200 end of the morning block to exactly 1000.

The controller's exact 1230 arrival and 4-hour installation requirement place G-19 in the 1300-1700 afternoon block, require G-12 to go first, and require a controller-receipt confirmation commitment and citation.
